//: Pack descriptor (PAR-4). Everything the shared governance harness needs to know about THIS pack.
//why: The portfolio gate and the lineage proof were benefits-only scripts with pack facts baked into them, so a second pack could not be gated without forking the harness - and forking the harness is exactly how four copies of the log readers drifted apart. Every pack-specific fact the gate needs now lives here, and the harness itself carries none.

runtime.name: benefits_runtime_agent
runtime.//: matched as a substring against ECR repositories when reporting toolkit residue

lineage.//lambda_stems: The governed tool Lambdas this pack deploys, as the stem after the <prefix>- in the function name. Declared because the lineage proof drops any CloudTrail invoke it cannot map to a tool identity (`if t:`), SILENTLY - so a governed Lambda whose name has no lexical overlap with the tool it hosts is simply absent from the parity check, and 'zero orphans' quietly means 'zero orphans among the ones that mapped'. tests/test_lineage_tool_mapping.py asserts every stem here resolves. Found 2026-09-08 while preparing REL-5 (L41).

tool_aliases.//: a Lambda stem with no lexical overlap with the aegis tool it hosts - the multi-tool core-tools function hosts the benefits_core drafter

workflow.//: the state a driven case must reach for LIN_case_driven to pass
